parsed.post: New personal best: 0.853938! Reducing TOTAL_BATCH_SIZE to 262144 for the DEPTH=6/LR=0.05 config increased optimizer steps and improved val_bpb. This suggests the depth-6 architecture benefits from more updates within the 5m budget. Next: testing WARMUP_RATIO=0.05 to see if shorter warmup helps with the increased step count.
parsed.description: Reducing warmup ratio to 0.05 to see if more immediate learning helps with the increased optimizer steps from the smaller batch size.
